releases.name: v0.2.1: All treat, no trick! 🎃
releases.body:
Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a new release, two months after the previous one. 

Before I get to the changelog, some special notes:

- From this release onwards, the old list of supported apps is replaced by the new, crowdsourced [touchHLE app compatibility database](https://appdb.touchhle.org/).
- In case you missed it, the [touchHLE app archive](https://touchhle.org/app-archive/) was recently launched. It only has one app at the moment, but that's hopefully just the start. If you were an indie developer in the early iPhone days, please get in touch!
- If you want to get notified about future releases, you might want to join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sVMXc8z3eS). You can't post there, but you'll be @'d with updates. There's also a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@touchHLE) where I post short gameplay videos with new releases.
- If you want to help me keep working on this full time, please consider [supporting me financially](https://liberapay.com/hikari_no_yume).

Finally, a big thanks to all the other contributors who made this release what it was! If it weren't for them, there might not have been any new game support in this release.

Happy Hallowee

releases.name: AzaharPlus 2126.2-A
releases.body:
⚠️⚠️⚠️
This version fixes a critical security vulnerability that was publicly announced so immediate update is advised
https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/security/advisories/GHSA-h74v-5mw8-qg8r
⚠️⚠️⚠️

AzaharPlus 2126.2-A is the same as Azahar 2126.2 except for this:

- Compatibility with all game files. If a file works with any Citra fork, it works with AzaharPlus.
- Ability to download system files from official servers. No need for an actual 3DS.
- Compatibility with older CPUs (no SSE4.2 required)
- Compatibility with Android 9
- ZipPass: A new way to exchange StreetPass data through zip files
- Built in cheats
- Amiibo generation
- Better multiplayer compatibility with other Citra forks

The Android build is available in 2 flavors.

- Replace: It has the same application id as Azahar, so it will replace it on the device.
Its display name is "AzaharPlus" and its icon background is blue.
Use this one if you have other apps that target Azahar, like a frontend for example.

- Coexist: It has a new application id so it can coexist with Azahar without issues.
Its display name is "+AzaharPlus+" and its icon background is red.

# YukiHub v0.4 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。
- **大屏模式新增回首页按钮**：右上角可直接退出大屏模式回到首页；原设置按钮同步改为图案化设计，并增加点击动效。
- **Yuki社区新增收藏集功能**（萌萌点回收计划二期）。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。
- **KRKR 内部存储启动**：属实验性功能，效果因游戏而异，如遇异常可改回原启动方式。
- **FVP 引擎更新仅涉及引擎侧**：不改变存档格式，原有存档可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.3.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**新引擎支持 · 大屏体验 · 社区互动 · 在线状态 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **新增 PC 引擎**：支持兼容 **Winlator-CN** 快捷启动。使用方法：手动选择 PC 引擎 → 添加游戏文件夹 → 选择 exe 文件启动即可。（请确保已安装 **Winlator-CN 1005 或更新版本**）
- **新增 FVP 引擎兼容启动**：FVP 引擎正式可用。
- **大屏模式新增搜索功能**：位于分类栏最上方，支持按游戏名与会社名搜索。
- **社区接入 NextMoe 贴纸表情包**：现在可以更愉快地带表情包发言了（bushi）。
- **在线状态区分手机 / 电脑端**：在线标记已区别化显示，为 PC 端接入做好准备。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **FVP 引擎新增虚拟鼠标按钮**：复用 KRKR / Artemis 的虚拟鼠标方案，操作更顺手。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复扫描入库的游戏固定使用 VNDB 源的问题**：扫描入库后现在会按设置中选择的资料源进行匹配，与手动添加保持一致。
- **修复大屏模式游玩时长不计入网页端每日任务的问题**：大屏游玩现在会正常上报服务端，经验与每日任务均可正常结算。
- **修复设置面板上下滑动时选项被误判为点击、导致界面被"硬控"的问题**。
- **修复 FVP 引擎视频播放问题**：需手动将原游戏视频转换为标准 MP4 格式 —— 编码 **H.264 (AVC)**、音频 **AAC**；720p 推荐 4000 比特率，1080p 推荐 6000 比特率。
- **移除 Bangumi 镜像源**：因镜像源频繁失效，已正式下线；此前使用镜像源的用户升级后将**自动切换为 Bangumi 官源**（官源访问可能需要一点 🔮）。

## 📌 说明

- 网络类静默失败已补充日志记录，开启日志后更便于排查问题。
- 以上修复均不涉及引擎存档镜像逻辑，原有存档数据不受影响。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.3 更新简介

> 本次更新聚焦：**UI 全面焕新 · 大屏模式 · 展厅功能 · 资讯与正版导购 · 账号体验 · 大量稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **大屏模式（主打）**：全新大屏播放体验，支持在大屏上畅享游戏 PV；新增从**文件夹**选取视频的来源（部分设备受系统限制无法从相册正常浏览图集，只能按时间一个个翻，很麻烦，现已绕开）。
- **首页接入 Gal 资讯**：打开 App 即可浏览最新 Galgame 动态。
- **正式接入 NextMoe 数据源**：账号快捷登录同步迁移为 **NextMoe·未萌** 快捷登录；聊天室支持 NextMoe 表情包。
- **游戏库正版导购**：网页社区游戏库新增游戏详情页，接入 **DLsite 正版链接** 与 **Steam 正版链接**（通过 Steam API 显示实时价格）。接入 NextMoe 分销链接，流量好的话后续会在社区发放 DL 正版游戏优惠券。
- **忘记密码 / 找回密码**：支持自助找回账号。
- **游戏时长编辑**：支持手动编辑游戏时长记录。
- **展厅玩法扩展**：3D 游戏展厅与多人在线展厅持续建设中，本版本新增音乐间（离线展厅可播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐），并支持共同观影等多人互动玩法。
- **多人在线展厅（重磅）**：全新网页端多人 3D 展厅上线！和朋友一起在线逛街、聊天、互动，包含：
  - 影院：共同观影、点播排队、投票换片、管理员管理（强制播放/跳片、远程灯光等）；
  - 音乐间：播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐，附赠一台古典音乐播放机；
  - 钓鱼等小游戏与更多互动玩法；
  - 离线展厅同步升级音乐间。
- **3D 游戏展厅**：以"逛博物馆"的仪式感重新设计，游戏以实体盒子陈列在虚拟 3D 房间中。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **UI 全面焕新**：整体视觉语言与配色体系全面重设计，界面更现代、更统一，观感焕然一新。
- 注册 / 登录页交互逻辑全面优化。
- 首页、游戏库按钮样式与配色统一化，UI 细节全面打磨。
- 手柄适配继续完善。
- 融合 GalToolbox 能力。
- 软件内更新默认源切换至 **GitCode**。
- 鲲 Gal 域名变更同步。

## 🛠 问题修复

- 修复好友列表"离线用户仍显示正在游玩"的 bug（根因为游戏时长未成功回传形成记录闭环）。
- 修复聊天室图片只缓存一半的问题。
- 修复验证码无动画反馈的问题。
- 修复共存版无法扫描添加文件的问题（初始库默认缺失生成项）。
- 修复游戏时长相关的若干功能 bug。
- ONS 游戏：视频播放改为**长按 2 秒跳过**（原为点击跳过，避免误触）。

## 📌 说明

- **PC 端同步**：PC 端版

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.

This release candidate fixes an audio-update parsing error that could cause invalid mixer data and audio glitches.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc5.

### What’s new since rc5

- **Audio update parsing:** the audio renderer now respects the splitter block size declared in the update header. Previously, it could read the following mixer block at the wrong offset, resulting in invalid mix counts or rejected audio updates.
- **Input validation:** added bounds checks for declared splitter blocks.
- **Regression coverage:** added synthetic tests covering splitter block boundaries, subsequent mixer updates, and header layout.

This correction addresses a likely cause of the audio errors reported in [issue #21](https://github.com/vricosti/ruzu-emu/issues/21). Confirmation through extended gameplay is still needed.

### Known limitations

Unsupported shader instructions may still cause missing graphics or prevent a scene from rendering. This release does not resolve every freeze, black-screen issue, or audio glitch.

Multi-program game compatibility remains experimental.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.5
releases.body:
Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.
- New shader instructions (16-bit multiply-add and ternary operations, VOP3 conversions, S_QUADMASK_B32, V_ASHRREV_I64) and faster shader transla

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.4
releases.body:
Fourth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. More than 100 games now run correctly according to testers' reports, and this release adds CapyPS5 Framegen. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **CapyPS5 Framegen:** optional frame generation. It draws in-between frames from the motion between two game frames, so a game at 30 FPS is shown at 60. Off by default; turn it on in *Settings → Performance* (1 per frame, or up to 3). Adds one frame of latency and some GPU load; works best from 25 FPS up.
- New performance options in *Settings → Performance*: shadow resolution, early depth testing and a frame rate limit (30 or 20 FPS).
- Physical keyboard input and an on-screen keyboard toggle for text fields, and system dialogs that can now be answered.
- Android 16 and devices with 16 KB memory pages are supported.

**Fixed**
- Unreal Engine 5 games: graphics and async compute hand work back and forth several times per frame, and each hand-off waited up to 100 ms. Menus that ran at 0–2 FPS now move.
- Games whose shadows use depth-compare texture gathers (Castlevania: Belmont's Curse) closed after the menu.
- Games built with MONITORX/MWAITX instru

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.3
releases.body:
Third alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for the logs testers sent on v0.0.2, CPU work for Unreal Engine games, and more from KytyPS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Games that use fibers (sceFiber) closed the emulator at start on ARM ("Fiber context switching is only implemented on x86_64", Toy Story Retro Roundup). Fibers now switch the game's own registers. First support: please report how fiber games behave.
- Final Fantasy VII Rebirth: sceKernelFtruncate, which it calls when saving, is now available.
- Mewgenics: pthread_setcanceltype is now available.
- The game clock (RDTSC) ran about 23 % faster than the frequency games are told; they now match.
- Very large GPU compute dispatches (over 65535 groups, as in Astro Bot) are split to fit Adreno limits.
- Unity backtraces no longer follow a bogus frame at the start of each guest thread.

**New**
- Unreal Engine games: the TLS and process clock reads they make millions of times a second run inside the game code instead of calling into the emulator.
- Shaders can read the real GPU clock (S_MEMREALTIME) on drivers that offer it.
- JpegDec and JpegEnc libraries, and more

- Dead Cells has its music, hits and footsteps back: NGS2 voices sent to a rack handle are now heard.
- Games that use user clip planes or uncommon storage texture settings no longer close.

- Trophies: each game's trophy list, what you have earned, and a card to share your progress.
- A "What's new" card after each update.
- Over 35 improvements from KytyPS5: shaders, tessellation, NGS2 and ATRAC9 audio, flip waits and fewer crashes.
